provenance.source: PyPSA-Eur prebuilt electricity network based on OpenStreetMap, v0.7
provenance.attribution: Xiong, Fioriti, Neumann, Riepin & Brown; © OpenStreetMap contributors
provenance.scope: Domestic AC connected component, represented as a lossless 380 kV DC equivalent. No HVDC or cross-border exchange.
provenance.operating_point: Illustrative assumption: 48 GW gross demand by source bus count; 4.2 GW fixed wind and 2.4 GW fixed PV. Costs, dispatch capacities and transformer X are assumptions.
